# Subject: Winter monitoring grant

# Body

The foundation offers support for twelve months of marsh monitoring, including
replacement sensors and winter field visits. The award covers data collection
and public release of validated readings. It does not fund new drainage works.

Acceptance requires a data management plan by the end of November. The project
should document missing observations rather than silently interpolate them.

# Signature

Programme officer, fictional Estuary Research Foundation.
